hook.text: Imagine losing your job tomorrow. Your savings drain. Friends disappear. Now open your eyes. You still have.

twist.text: This is not pessimism. It is inoculation.

climax.text: Spend one minute each morning imagining what you could lose.

punchline.text: Imagine the worst. Appreciate what you have now.

quiz.question: What is premeditatio malorum?
options: Planning for the best possible outcome
Imagining worst-case scenarios to build resilience
